mcq_fix.s: R.C. Majumdar, unlike the nationalist school, argued that the Revolt of 1857 was:

pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: drain theory / economic nationalism
wrong topic: socialist leaders in national movement
wrong topic: consequences of 1857 / army reorganisation
suspect key: S.N. Sen was official historian of 1857; Tara Chand of the freedom struggle

patterns: Dominant shape: 'Who called 1857 the First War of Independence?' -> Savarkar, with Majumdar, Sen, Tilak as distractors.
Quote-attribution: 'neither first, nor national, nor a war of independence' -> R.C. Majumdar; embryonic nationalism -> Majumdar and Sen.
British-school labels by name: Outram & Taylor (conspiracy), Lawrence/Seeley (sepoy mutiny), Holmes, Rees.
Participation items: educated middle class neutral/aloof; princes and Rajput rulers loyal; failure due to lack of central organisation.
App has more multi-statement and interpretive items (Stokes, Mukherjee) than PYQ depth; PYQs are single-fact attribution.
